pixel_interpretation: modelled residential population assigned to that ~100 m grid cell
nodata_meaning: cell has no modelled residential population (unsettled / non-residential); NOT a surveyed zero and NOT missing data to be imputed
attribution: Population data: WorldPop (www.worldpop.org - School of Geography and Environmental Science, University of Southampton). Global High Resolution Population Denominators Project. Constrained individual countries 2020, UN-adjusted, 100 m. DOI: 10.5258/SOTON/WP00684. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
clip_command: python clip_ujjani.py  (rasterio window read of the requested bbox from the source transform; round_offsets/round_lengths; no reprojection, no resampling; GTiff COMPRESS=DEFLATE PREDICTOR=3 TILED=YES)
exposure_method: flood-polygon raster mask of the population raster in its native EPSG:4326 grid; cell-centre inclusion (rasterio.mask all_touched=False); NoData / non-finite cells excluded from the sum; persons-per-pixel summed. The raster is NOT reprojected or resampled; only the flood polygon is transformed if its CRS differs.
result_classification: DERIVED IMPACT (estimate) - estimated residential population within the modelled flood inundation extent; NOT people displaced / affected / casualties / evacuated / surveyed
temporal_caveat: 2020 population estimate overlaid on a modelled (hypothetical) flood extent; not the population present at the time of any specific past or future event
limitations: constrained product: population is confined to cells mapped as built settlement circa 2020; small or new settlements may be missing
3 arc-second pixels are ~92 m N-S and ~87 m E-W at 18 N, not exactly 100 m
boundary pixels use centre inclusion (all-or-nothing); fractional-overlap weighting is a possible future refinement
UN-adjusted national total is aligned to UN World Population Prospects 2019
input census framework is India's, projected to 2020 by WorldPop
